text: APPROVE. The filters, the `isRemovingRule` branching and the per-declaration checks are logically identical to the original (the skip conditions are correctly negated, `Any` short-circuits like the early `return true`, and every extracted parameter is used), and `Replaced` now has a cognitive complexity of roughly 7. I only read the diff and did not build the project or run the tests, so the build condition is inferred: no unused or new-API usage is evident, but warnings-as-errors was not checked.
